cues.en: Now that you have a conceptual overview of how the perceptron works, I'm going to go through the math and the mechanics of deep learning in more detail.
cues.zh: 現在你對感知器如何運作，已經有概念上的理解，接著要更深入介紹深度學習的數學與機制。

cues.en: Fortunately, it's not that hard.
cues.zh: 幸好，沒有那麼難。

cues.en: In fact, you already know all the math that you need to understand deep learning.
cues.zh: 其實，理解深度學習需要的數學，你都已經知道。

cues.en: It's just a matter of putting all the pieces together in the right order.
cues.zh: 只要把各個部分，按照正確順序組合起來。

cues.en: Now, I've broken up this lecture into three parts to make it a little bit more digestible.
cues.zh: 為了方便消化，我把這堂課拆成三部分。

cues.en: This first video will cover what's called forward propagation, and is basically how the input data are transformed into the output.
cues.zh: 第一支介紹前向傳播，基本上就是輸入資料如何轉換成輸出。

cues.en: So here you see a familiar diagram of the perceptron model, which is actually the fundamental building block of deep learning.
cues.zh: 這裡是熟悉的感知器示意圖，它其實是深度學習的基本構件。

cues.en: And you'll learn later on that what makes deep learning deep is that we take exactly this simple model and repeat it lots and lots of times.
cues.zh: 之後會學到，深度學習之所以深，就是把這個簡單模型重複很多次。

cues.en: So we take a bunch of these perceptrons and we string them all up together.
cues.zh: 取一群感知器，把它們全部連起來。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: So quick reminder here.
cues.zh: 快速提醒。

cues.en: In this example we have two inputs.
cues.zh: 這個例子有兩個輸入。

cues.en: So two features of the real world.
cues.zh: 也就是真實世界的兩個特徵。

cues.en: Like maybe this is the number of hours that the students slept and the number of hours that the students studied.
cues.zh: 例如學生睡了幾小時，以及讀了幾小時。

cues.en: This is called the bias term here.
cues.zh: 這裡叫做偏置項。

cues.en: These are the weights.
cues.zh: 這些是權重。

cues.en: And so this part of the perceptron here this node is implementing a linear weighted sum of the inputs.
cues.zh: 感知器的這個節點，計算的是輸入的線性加權總和。

cues.en: And it gives a single number as an output.
cues.zh: 輸出一個數字。

cues.en: So that's the linear part of the computation.
cues.zh: 這是計算的線性部分。

cues.en: Then that linear output passes through a nonlinear function which we call an activation function.
cues.zh: 接著，線性輸出經過非線性函式，我們稱為活化函式。

cues.en: I want to write out all of the math again to show you a simplification.
cues.zh: 我想把數學再寫一遍，示範如何簡化。

cues.en: So here is the output of the model y hat equals all of the individual inputs in the x's multiplied by their corresponding weights in the W's.
cues.zh: 模型輸出 y-hat，等於各個輸入 x，乘上對應的權重 w。

cues.en: And then those are summed up together.
cues.zh: 再把它們加起來。

cues.en: And we add to that the bias term and its weight.
cues.zh: 另外加上偏置輸入，乘以偏置權重。

cues.en: Now remember that this term here is simply the dot product between a vector containing the inputs and a vector containing the weights.
cues.zh: 記得，這一項就是輸入向量，和權重向量之間的內積。

cues.en: Furthermore, we generally set this bias term to one.
cues.zh: 而且，一般把這個偏置輸入設成一。

cues.en: So this term is one.
cues.zh: 所以這一項是一。

cues.en: So we can just drop x0 from the equation.
cues.zh: 可以從式子裡省略 x_0。

cues.en: So this is the linear part which passes through the nonlinear activation function.
cues.zh: 這是線性部分，接著通過非線性活化函式。

cues.en: And now it turns out that we can actually remove this w0 altogether and simply write sigma of x transpose w.
cues.zh: 其實，還可以把這個 w_0 完全省略不另寫，直接寫 sigma(x 轉置乘以 w)。

cues.en: So writing out the bias term here explicitly is useful from a conceptual perspective, because it reminds
cues.zh: 明確寫出偏置，對概念理解很有幫助，因為會提醒，

cues.en: you that there is a bias, but that bias term can actually be absorbed into the dot product.
cues.zh: 你模型裡有偏置，但它其實可以併入內積。

cues.en: Now, I'd like to take a moment to explain why this is the case.
cues.zh: 花點時間解釋原因。

cues.en: Here I'm simply writing out all of the individual terms from the equation here.
cues.zh: 這裡，只是把原式各項明確展開。

cues.en: So we expand this summation for m equals two.
cues.zh: 把 m 等於二時的加總展開。

cues.en: And that gives us this expression here.
cues.zh: 就得到這個運算式。

cues.en: Now because we know that we can represent the dot product as the matrix multiplication of two vectors.
cues.zh: 因為知道，內積可以表示為兩個向量的矩陣乘法。

cues.en: We can also express the dot product in this form.
cues.zh: 所以也可以用這種形式表示。

cues.en: Again these are all the same expressions.
cues.zh: 再次強調，這些式子完全相同。

cues.en: I'm just writing them out using different notations.
cues.zh: 只是使用不同符號。

cues.en: And now here I can simply augment these two vectors with x0 here and w0 over here and here.
cues.zh: 現在，可以用這裡的 x_0 和那邊的 w_0，擴充這兩個向量。

cues.en: Just as in all of these cases, I'm assuming that x0 is equal to one.
cues.zh: 和其他情況一樣，都假設 x_0 等於一。

cues.en: So we simply put a one into this vector of inputs over here.
cues.zh: 所以，在輸入向量裡加上一。

cues.en: And so this shows that the bias can be absorbed into the dot product.
cues.zh: 這就顯示，偏置可以併入內積。

cues.en: Now, the reason why I show all of this is because I'm going to start writing out the computation of the perceptron using this notation.
cues.zh: 之所以展示全部過程，是因為之後會開始用這種符號，寫感知器的計算。

cues.en: So sigma of x transpose W without taking the extra space for the bias term.
cues.zh: 也就是 sigma(x 轉置乘以 w)，不另外寫偏置項。

cues.en: But of course you know that the bias term is always included.
cues.zh: 但當然，偏置一直都包含在裡面。

cues.en: So this little model has two inputs, which means this is a 2D input space which means a two dimensional feature space.
cues.zh: 這個小模型有兩個輸入，所以是二維輸入空間，也就是二維特徵空間。

cues.en: So for now I am setting the activation function to be the identity function, which is actually just the number one.
cues.zh: 目前把活化函式設成恆等函數，也就是數字一。

cues.en: So in fact there is no non-linearity in this model.
cues.zh: 所以，這個模型其實沒有非線性。

cues.en: It's totally linear.
cues.zh: 完全是線性的。

cues.en: This is just here as a convenient placeholder.
cues.zh: 這裡只是方便放一個佔位。

cues.en: And this is convenient because it means that we can just write out the equation for this model, this computational graph.
cues.zh: 這樣很方便，因為可以直接寫出模型，也就是計算圖的方程式。

cues.en: And that's what you see here.
cues.zh: 就是這裡看到的。

cues.en: So y hat equals one.
cues.zh: y-hat 等於一。

cues.en: Now this one over here comes from the bias term x0 and times one.
cues.zh: 這個一，來自偏置輸入 x_0，再乘以一。

cues.en: I'm saying the weight to be one here, so implicitly there is a times the orange one over here anyway.
cues.zh: 我把這裡的權重設成一，所以隱含還乘上這個橘色的一。

cues.en: And here we have plus minus two times x1, where minus two is the weight plus one times x2 where one is this weight over here.
cues.zh: 這裡再加上負二乘 x1，負二是權重，再加一乘 x2，一是這個權重。

cues.en: And in fact we can visualize this function in the two dimensional feature space.
cues.zh: 其實，可以在二維特徵空間裡，視覺化這個函式。

cues.en: So the input space and that looks like this.
cues.zh: 也就是輸入空間，看起來像這樣。

cues.en: So we have two dimensions here x1 and x2 corresponding to the two inputs.
cues.zh: 有 x1 與 x2 兩個維度，對應兩個輸入。

cues.en: And so each data sample each data point in our data set is a coordinate in this space.
cues.zh: 所以，資料集裡每個樣本、每個資料點，都是這個空間的一組座標。

cues.en: And the input at each coordinate gives a value at that coordinate, which is determined by this function here, and is represented by this pseudo color bar over here.
cues.zh: 每組座標的輸入，都會依照這個函式得到一個值，並用這裡的偽色彩色條表示。

cues.en: So just to make sure that this is clear we can pick a few values in here.
cues.zh: 為了確保清楚，挑幾個值看看。

cues.en: Now the easiest ones to pick are zero and zero.
cues.zh: 最容易選的，是零和零。

cues.en: So we set x one equals x two equals zero.
cues.zh: 把 x1 與 x2 都設成零。

cues.en: That's this point at the origin.
cues.zh: 就是原點。

cues.en: So obviously that just gets rid of these two terms.
cues.zh: 很明顯，這兩項都會消失。

cues.en: And then we find that y hat equals one at the origin.
cues.zh: 所以原點的 y-hat 等於一。

cues.en: And you know it's not really hard.
cues.zh: 這其實不難，

cues.en: It's not really easy to see the exact color value.
cues.zh: 只是很難直接看出確切色值。

cues.en: But it's plausibly equal to a color value of one.
cues.zh: 但這個顏色合理地對應到一。

cues.en: If you like, you can pause the video and pick a few other values.
cues.zh: 如果願意，可以暫停影片，挑幾個其他數值。

cues.en: For example, maybe x1 equals minus two and x2 equals plus two.
cues.zh: 例如 x1 等於負二，x2 等於正二。

cues.en: So that's this point here.
cues.zh: 也就是這個點。

cues.en: I don't really feel like calculating that, but I'm sure it's going to be you know you can tell from the color it's going to be somewhere around here seven, eight, something like that, maybe nine.
cues.zh: 我不太想算，但從顏色看，大概是這附近，七、八之類的，也許九。

cues.en: Now you can see that this function in this feature space has positive values and negative values.
cues.zh: 現在可以看到，這個特徵空間裡的函式，有正值，也有負值。

cues.en: So therefore it's also going to have values or range of values where the function is equal to zero.
cues.zh: 所以也會有函式等於零的位置或範圍。

cues.en: Or we get a value of zero.
cues.zh: 也就是結果為零。

cues.en: In fact there's a line in this feature space for all the points where y hat equals zero.
cues.zh: 事實上，特徵空間裡有一條線，上面各點的 y-hat 都等於零。

cues.en: And we find this line by setting this equation to zero and finding all of the x1, x2 pairs that satisfy this equation, and you know it's easiest to compute for these two points on the line.
cues.zh: 把這個式子設成零，找出所有符合的 x1、x2 組合，就得到這條線；最容易計算的是線上這兩個點。

cues.en: So just by way of a quick confirmation, let's see that when x1 equals zero.
cues.zh: 快速確認，當 x1 等於零時，

cues.en: So now we're on this y axis line here.
cues.zh: 也就是在這條 y 軸上。

cues.en: When x1 equals zero this term drops out.
cues.zh: x1 等於零，這一項消失。

cues.en: And then to get this equation to be equal to zero this needs to be x2 needs to be minus one so that this is one plus minus one.
cues.zh: 要讓整式等於零，x2 就必須是負一，這樣就是一加負一。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: So that's this one.
cues.zh: 就是這個點。

cues.en: Of course you can you know you can pause the video and compute this here.
cues.zh: 當然，也可以暫停影片，算另一個點。

cues.en: I'm sure you will get that when x1 x2 equals zero x1 must equal one half.
cues.zh: 你一定會得到，x1——是 x2 等於零時，x1 必須是二分之一。

cues.en: Actually we can already see that very quickly from looking at the equation.
cues.zh: 其實，直接看式子就能很快看出來。

cues.en: Now why do we care about this line?
cues.zh: 為什麼在意這條線？

cues.en: This line is important because it is the separating hyperplane or the decision boundary.
cues.zh: 因為它是分隔超平面，也就是決策邊界。

cues.en: It cuts this feature space into two discrete parts.
cues.zh: 把特徵空間切成兩個不同部分。

cues.en: And these two discrete parts are the two categories, or sometimes called classes.
cues.zh: 這兩個部分，就是兩個類別，有時也叫 class。

cues.en: So now the idea is that any samples, any data points in this part of the feature space will be labeled as category one or class one.
cues.zh: 所以，特徵空間這一側的所有樣本、資料點，都會標成第一類。

cues.en: And any combination of x1, x2 values, any input pairs that lie in this part of space will be categorized as being in class two or category two.
cues.zh: 而落在另一側的任何 x1、x2 輸入組合，都會被分到第二類。

cues.en: Now this is basically how a linear classifier works.
cues.zh: 這基本上就是線性分類器的運作方式。

cues.en: Now the slope of this line, the slope and the intercept of this line, all of the values of y and so on.
cues.zh: 這條線的斜率、截距，以及所有 y 值等等，

cues.en: Those all depend on the values of w here and w0.
cues.zh: 都取決於這裡的 w 與 w_0。

cues.en: So on the bias term and on the weights.
cues.zh: 也就是偏置與權重。

cues.en: I'm going to talk more about that in a few moments.
cues.zh: 稍後會再談。

cues.en: But first I want to get back to talking about this activation function.
cues.zh: 但先回到活化函式。

cues.en: Here an activation function is a function that maps an input, which is actually the output of the linear
cues.zh: 活化函式，把一個輸入，也就是模型線性，

cues.en: part of the model onto an output, which is the final output of the model.
cues.zh: 部分的輸出，映射成模型最終輸出。

cues.en: So the identity function that I used in the previous slide would actually just be a straight line through this space here.
cues.zh: 上一張投影片使用的恆等函數，在這個空間裡就是一條直線。

cues.en: So the output value equals the input value.
cues.zh: 輸出值等於輸入值。

cues.en: But more generally the idea is that the output of the linear part of the model is the input into this non-linear activation function.
cues.zh: 一般來說，模型線性部分的輸出，會成為非線性活化函式的輸入。

cues.en: And from there that gets mapped onto some output value.
cues.zh: 再映射到某個輸出值。

cues.en: Here y hat.
cues.zh: 這裡就是 y-hat。

cues.en: There are many activation functions that have been used in deep learning, perhaps maybe a few dozen activation functions.
cues.zh: 深度學習用過很多活化函式，可能有數十種。

cues.en: But these three here are the most common activation functions.
cues.zh: 但這三個，是最常見的活化函式。

cues.en: And in fact, many of the other activation functions are actually just variants of one of these three.
cues.zh: 很多其他活化函式，其實都是這三個的變體。

cues.en: Now there's a much larger discussion to be had about why we need different activation functions and when to use which function.
cues.zh: 為什麼需要不同活化函式，以及什麼時候該用哪個，是很大的主題。

cues.en: That is a discussion that we are going to have separately later in the course.
cues.zh: 之後會另外討論。

cues.en: But briefly.
cues.zh: 簡短來說，

cues.en: The sigmoid is generally used for the final output of the model, and the tangent and ReLU functions are often used for nodes in the middle of a model.
cues.zh: sigmoid 通常用於模型最終輸出；tanh 與 ReLU，則經常用於模型中間的節點。

cues.en: But importantly, you can see that none of these activation functions is a straight line, so all of these are non-linear.
cues.zh: 重點是，這些活化函式都不是一條直線，所以全都是非線性的。

cues.en: For example, if the output of this linear part of the model is, let's say a value of minus four.
cues.zh: 例如，模型線性部分的輸出，是負四。

cues.en: So that's the input into the activation function that would be on the x axis down here.
cues.zh: 這就是活化函式的輸入，位於下面 x 軸的位置。

cues.en: And if this activation function were a sigmoid then the output of the linear component being minus four would produce an output of the sigmoid function of somewhere close to zero.
cues.zh: 如果活化函式是 sigmoid，線性部分輸出的負四，就會產生接近零的 sigmoid 輸出。

cues.en: And here for the hyperbolic tangent, the output would be around minus one.
cues.zh: 如果是雙曲正切，輸出大約是負一。

cues.en: Here for ReLU it would be zero.
cues.zh: 如果是 ReLU，則是零。

cues.en: Now this is an important but subtle point.
cues.zh: 這是很重要、但細微的一點。

cues.en: Each node in the model is internally computing a linear operation, but the output of that part of the
cues.zh: 每個節點內部先計算線性運算，但這部分的，

cues.en: node is transformed through a non-linearity, and that non-linear component is going to be the input into the next node in a model.
cues.zh: 輸出會經過非線性轉換，而這個非線性結果，會成為模型下一個節點的輸入。

cues.en: So the nodes are linear coming in and non-linear going out.
cues.zh: 所以，節點進來時是線性的，出去時是非線性的。

cues.en: Here you see the same feature space and the same model that we were looking at before.
cues.zh: 這裡是剛才相同的特徵空間與模型。

cues.en: But now this is just the linear part of the model.
cues.zh: 但這裡只有模型的線性部分。

cues.en: And here we have that linear part pushed through this non-linear sigmoid function over here.
cues.zh: 這裡則讓線性部分通過非線性的 sigmoid。

cues.en: So that you see represented graphically.
cues.zh: 圖形上就像這樣。

cues.en: And here is how you see it written expressed algebraically.
cues.zh: 代數上，則是這樣表示。

cues.en: Now the separating hyperplane or where this function is equal to zero that we saw, you saw that with
cues.zh: 分隔超平面，也就是這個函式等於零的地方，前幾張投影片，

cues.en: the line I drew a few slides ago that well I don't have the line here, but it's in the same exact spot in this graph and in this graph.
cues.zh: 畫過那條線；這裡沒有畫，但在這兩張圖中，位置完全相同。

cues.en: But the sigmoid function added a non-linearity that changed the values of that function.
cues.zh: sigmoid 加入了非線性，改變函式值。

cues.en: So here this function, these values are all bound between 0 and 1.
cues.zh: 這裡的所有數值，都被限制在零到一之間。

cues.en: Whereas here these were not actually bound.
cues.zh: 另一邊則沒有界限。

cues.en: So you know I clipped the color scale at minus ten to plus ten.
cues.zh: 雖然，我把色階裁在負十到正十。

cues.en: But these values here can grow arbitrarily large or arbitrarily small negative.
cues.zh: 但那些數值可以任意變大，或者變得任意小、任意負。

cues.en: And here these values are clipped between 0 and 1.
cues.zh: 這裡的值，則限制在零到一。

cues.en: And you can also see that most of the values in this graph are at the extremes.
cues.zh: 也可以看到，大部分數值都在兩個極端。

cues.en: So most of the values are very close to zero or are very close to one.
cues.zh: 大部分都很接近零，或很接近一。

cues.en: And that changes the interpretation of the samples in this feature space.
cues.zh: 這會改變，如何解讀特徵空間裡的樣本。

cues.en: So now the values in this plot are used as probabilities of each sample being drawn from one category.
cues.zh: 現在，圖裡的值會被視為，各樣本屬於某一類別的機率。

cues.en: So when there is a student who slept, you know, this many hours and studied for this many hours, says the model computes.
cues.zh: 例如，一位學生睡了這麼多小時、讀了這麼多小時，模型計算後，

cues.en: So the model is going to say, I compute that there is a 9.9% chance, so a 0.999 chance of this student
cues.zh: 會說，我算出這位學生有百分之九點九，也就是零點九九九的機會，

cues.en: passing the exam.
cues.zh: 考試及格。

cues.en: Likewise, if there's a student who slept this much and studied this much, then the model says, I compute that there's a probability of 0.00327.
cues.zh: 同樣，如果某位學生睡這麼久、讀這麼久，模型會說，機率是零點零零三二七。

cues.en: You know, whatever this number is down here.
